The National Economic Council meeting was held in Glasgow on Friday, at which Prime Minister Andy Burnham met with Scottish First Minister John Swinney and Welsh First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth. Northern Ireland representatives Michelle O'Neill and Emma Little-Pengelly were unable to attend.
Sinn Féin MP John Finucane said it was a "disgrace" that leaders were not attending the National Economic Council in Glasgow.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham, chairing the meeting, said it was "a shame that we do not have colleagues from Northern Ireland."
